description: This file defines a custom adapter class 'CustomRecyclerAdapter' for an Android Wearable app, used to bind data to a RecyclerView in the context of Wear notifications. It includes a ViewHolder subclass and handles item click events to communicate with a controller.

classes.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of string data in a Wearable app, with support for item click handling via a controller.

classes.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: Holds references to the views for each list item, specifically a TextView.

methods.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing data set and controller.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to views and sets click listeners that notify the controller.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the size of the data set.

methods.name: ViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that finds the TextView within the item layout.
